capture_transport: local ScreenCaptureKit real-time application-audio recording, source playbackRate 1
audio_scope: Aside application PID filter, not single-tab isolation; microphone excluded

excluded_preserved_attempts.reason: silent full capture before genuine active-tab correction; excluded from valid set
nonzero partial capture stopped before original time cap; excluded from valid set

limitations: UI-to-PTS boundaries are estimates; browser output latency is uncalibrated.
App-only capture can include other audible Aside tabs.
Capture completeness is not direct-listening or musical-quality approval.
BPM, downbeats, transitions and any 170 BPM derivative remain separate analysis/production work.
